purpose: Determine whether Q4_K oneDNN weight-decompression-on-compute fits and materially improves the TP2 c64 route that otherwise dequantizes weights to F16 before GEMM.
why_not_redundant: Prior attempts were TP1 and failed from per-card reorder residency before an engaged B64 WDC result. TP2 halves weight residency per card and has not been tested.

common: Q4_K_M target-only, F16 KV, flash attention, batch 2048, ubatch 256, context 32768, 8 threads, poll 50
matched_runtime.isolation_reason: Both arms pay identical Q4_K plane-reorder residency and both suppress q6_K reorder; only the Q4_K matmul implementation differs.

measurement.candidate_liveness: resolved WDC q4_K banner is on and a non-mutant WDC-CENSUS ENGAGED line is present
measurement.control_liveness: resolved WDC q4_K banner is off and no WDC-CENSUS ENGAGED line is present

advance_if.next_stage: build the same candidate's llama-server target, then preregister two fresh output-qualified HTTP c64 replications and strict mixed-content parity before any package change

stop_rules: Stop and retain unsupported evidence on OOM, device loss, Xe fault/reset/hang, missing row, missing liveness, or source/binary identity mismatch.
Do not publish raw batched-bench throughput or infer HTTP throughput from it.
Do not weaken output or quality gates if the mechanism screen passes.
